description: Header file declaring functions for retrieving PUSCH Time Domain resource indices based on cell and UE configurations, including functions for standard, per-slot, and fairly distributed resource index retrieval in TDD/FDD scenarios.

methods.name: get_pusch_td_resource_indices
methods.description: Returns a list of applicable PUSCH Time Domain resource indexes based on cell, UE configuration, and slot parameters.

methods.name: get_pusch_td_resource_indices_per_slot
methods.description: Returns a circularly indexed list of PUSCH Time Domain resource indexes per slot, considering TDD/FDD configurations.

methods.name: get_fairly_distributed_pusch_td_resource_indices
methods.description: Returns a fairly distributed list of PUSCH Time Domain resource indexes per slot, optimized for UL-heavy TDD patterns.
